# 7453 - 4x2 AND-OR-INVERT (7453 - 7454)

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7453.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7453.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 13 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7453 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7453.png) | ![7453 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-7453.png) | ![7453 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-7453.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | A | input |  |  |
| 2 | C | input |  |  |
| 3 | D | input |  |  |
| 4 | E | input |  |  |
| 5 | F | input |  |  |
| 6 | NC | nc |  |  |
| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |
| 8 | Y | output | totem-pole |  |
| 9 | G | input |  |  |
| 10 | H | input |  |  |
| 11 | X | analog |  | expander node: connect to the X output of a 7460 expander; leave open if not used |
| 12 | /X | analog |  | expander node: connect to the X-bar output of a 7460 expander; leave open if not used |
| 13 | B | input |  |  |
| 14 | VCC | power |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | Y = NOT ((A AND B) OR (C AND D) OR (E AND F) OR (G AND H) OR X) | Y is low when any of the pairs AB, CD, EF, GH is all high, or an expander on X/X' has all its inputs high (X = output of a 7460). |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.4 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Designed for use with up to four 7460 expanders. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, expander pins open.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 13 | 22 |
| any | Y | PHL | 8 | 15 |

## Not known

- Propagation delay of the 7453 when driven through a 7460 expander: the table gives that row only for the '50.

## Notes

The manual title groups 7453 and 7454; this file describes the expandable 7453. The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.
